profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a natural passion and curiosity for computer programming. An enthusiastic learner with strong communication, data analysis, and organizational skills. Team builder with an open mind for travel and relocation.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
- Developed the strategic plan for creating a mobile app for the Department of Defense. 
- Developed an application within the constraints of DoD standards and compliance with information assurance concerns. 
- Oversee as lead student project manager

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted professors with tutoring students in Java and C++ program coding;  100% of students tutored received an A in the class. 
- Assisted in the preparation of lectures, leading discussion sections, conducting laboratory exercises, grading papers, and keeping class record.

positions.title: Lead Student IT Intern
positions.description:
- Managed 10 interns and projects that addressed technical needs of students, faculty, and staff. 
- Responded to telephone calls, instant messages, emails, and personnel requests for technical support. 
- Performed other duties or special projects as requested related to area of responsibility.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Organized and analyzed Excel forecasting and strategic data/reports, which improved government official's efficiency to access and transfer files within Department of Energy. 
- Developed an alternative data-driven capital investment model using quantitative methods to help with political, budgetary, and programmatic decision factor. 
- Participated in a literary research case study and gave an oral presentation. 
- Researched and presented a write-up on the site's budgeting strategies.
